item.title: Understanding Low Mood
item.description: This article is a summary of Chapter 1, “Understanding Low Mood," from Dr. Julie Smith’s bestselling book Why Has Nobody Told Me This Before?. The Mask We Wear: Relatability in the Struggle In Chapter 1, Dr. Julie addresses a universal struggle: the tendency to mask low mood. Many of us reflexively push these feelings away or hide them behind a brave face, viewing a dip in mood as a personal failure or a “fault” in our brains rather than a signal to be understood.
